segments.name: Ophthalmic surgical product segment
segments.description: Designs, manufactures and sells implantable Collamer lenses (ICLs) and accessory delivery systems for refractive eye surgery worldwide.
segments.evidence: 100% of the Company's sales are generated from the ophthalmic surgical product segment and, therefore, the Company operates as one operating segment for financial reporting purposes.

revenueModel.text: STAAR earns revenue almost exclusively from sales of its ICLs to customers, recognized upon shipment when control transfers, with payment typically collected shortly thereafter.
revenueModel.evidence: STAAR generates worldwide revenue almost exclusively from sales of our Implantable Collamer Lenses, or "ICLs."

changes.text: In fiscal 2023 the Company phased out sales of its cataract IOL product line, selling none in fiscal 2024 or 2025.
changes.evidence: The Company phased out sales of such products in fiscal 2023, and it did not sell any such products in fiscal 2024 or 2025.
